scope: Source-audited operation authority and store ownership enabler; not runtime authorization or contract freeze
inventoryRules: Controller registration is current source evidence; all other proposed grants require implementation and acceptance.
UI groups retain dated checkpoint metadata only; their state is not current runtime/provider acceptance.
Source fingerprints normalize CRLF to LF; drift requires renewed semantic review. Regeneration is not approval.
No client UID/role/workspace/consent flag, preview guard, signed URL, queue event, payer status or ML output independently grants authority.

none.authority: No durable owning store for this operation; public config/static output or CSRF cookie only

auth.authority: Firebase Auth verifies identity; Firestore visionary_accounts/{uid}, UID devices/authEvents, server session lookup and auth operational counters/events; IAM Admin SDK, not browser rules

billing.authority: Firestore visionary_accounts/{uid}/billing/test plus commands/invoices; separate test queue, subscription/payment/event/invitation/membership indexes; provider verifies external payment facts

feedback.authority: Firestore UID-nested feedback/commands and admission counters through current account authority

learning.authority: Firestore visionary_accounts/{uid}/learningSessions with checks/assessments and learningCommands; owning transaction, no SQL cutover implied

knowledge.authority: Firestore UID-nested knowledgeCommands/Receipts/Projections/Outbox; calibrated metadata is not a second learner-evidence owner

workspaceProvision.authority: Opt-in PostgreSQL domain transaction/receipt plus Firestore pending/completion reconciliation; local/staging developmentWorkspaceLinks are isolated from production domainLinks; existing account remains Firestore-owned; not distributed ACID or hosted acceptance

domain.authority: Selected reviewed owning domain store pending DATA-01 and authority/policy acceptance; legacy imported Prisma schema is not deployed authority

privateObjects.authority: Private object bytes plus owning-domain metadata; no upload/download service installed by this inventory

jobs.authority: Owning-domain transactional outbox/job receipt plus scoped worker orchestration; no independent queue authorization or cross-store transaction assumed

profileTarget.authority: One profile owning store must be selected; existing UID account remains Firestore and future account projections do not create dual mutable authority

public.actor: Anonymous public caller; no authenticated identity inferred

csrf.actor: Anonymous bootstrap; random CSRF cookie/token is not identity

exchange.actor: Firebase-verified ID token, current identity admission and rate limits; existing cookie/device binding retained
exchange.workspace: Onboarding role/preferences grant no verified membership
exchange.object: Verified UID account/session/device; current session-policy epoch/cutoff
exchange.consent: No guardian or model-processing consent inferred

sessionRead.actor: Verified current session AND device; /me does not require expected-account header

ownerRead.actor: Verified current session/device and compared X-Visionary-Account hint
ownerRead.object: UID-derived account/device/invoice records; cursors stay within owner collection

ownerWrite.actor: Verified current session/device, expected-account match, exact Origin and CSRF; rate limits
ownerWrite.workspace: Self-reported role/workspace preferences are not membership
ownerWrite.object: UID-owned profile/onboarding with transaction session-version check

logout.actor: Exact Origin/CSRF; device lookup plus expected UID OR matching cookie hash; no-op for absent/invalid device
logout.object: Only selected device/session revocation and cookie cleanup; not ordinary full-session authentication

logoutAll.actor: Enabled action, verified session cookie/device binding and expected UID; transaction epoch and replay checks
logoutAll.object: Current UID session-policy epoch/cutoff, device/session revocation and auth events

billingRead.actor: Verified current session/device plus expected-account match; passive read
billingRead.object: Current UID billing/test and owner invoice; Family invitation reads also match verified payer email/expiry/status
billingRead.consent: Family billing benefit is not guardian/learning-data consent

billingWrite.actor: Browser writer helper requires current session/device/account, Origin/CSRF and billing rate limit
billingWrite.object: Server UID payer/test subscription or owned Family seats; recipient acceptance checks addressed verified email and current seat state
billingWrite.consent: Billing agreement/seat acceptance does not prove guardian relationship

billingJob.actor: Configured reconciliation credential checked by provider.authorizeReconciliation; browser cookies are insufficient
billingJob.object: Server due queue, UID-owned test billing and transactional leases; bounded reconciliation
billingJob.consent: No private educational access or support impersonation

billingWebhook.actor: HMAC over exact raw bytes, bounded event ID/digest; test merchant mapping; no browser CSRF requirement
billingWebhook.object: Server subscription/payment mapping, deduplicated provider event and due queue; unmapped event grants nothing
billingWebhook.consent: Provider event is not guardian/learning consent

feedbackRead.object: Only UID-owned feedback page; bounded UUID cursor; no operator listing
feedbackRead.consent: Feedback is not training consent or an emergency/support case

feedbackWrite.actor: Current session/device/account, exact Origin/CSRF; service admission and command identity
feedbackWrite.object: Only UID-owned optional feedback, command receipt and counters
feedbackWrite.consent: No automatic Jira export, model training or staff/guardian read

learningRead.workspace: workspaceId is an owner-collection filter/tag, not a verified membership grant
learningRead.object: UID-nested learning sessions; stored UID checked; no raw answer-key projection
learningRead.source: Stored source/criteria versions bind record consistency; published rights/withdrawal authority remains missing
learningRead.consent: No teacher/guardian/employer access or consent grant

learningWrite.workspace: Owner records only; workspace tag consistency is not membership proof
learningWrite.object: UID-nested session/command/assessment transaction, expected revision and replay fingerprint; server scores stored authored key
learningWrite.source: Source/provider/criteria references and authored check input are bounded client input; no independent approved-source authority is established

knowledgeRead.workspace: Owner projection scoped by workspace/concept/source/criteria; no verified membership added
knowledgeRead.object: UID-nested knowledge projection or selected model metadata; pKnown is not assessed mastery
knowledgeRead.source: Exact source/criteria/model compatibility, not published-source licensing
knowledgeRead.consent: No cross-user reporting or model-data permission

knowledgeWrite.workspace: Scope derived from owned saved session/assessment; consistency checked
knowledgeWrite.object: Owned immutable assessment receipt to projection/command/receipt/outbox transaction; bounded replay/rebuild checks
knowledgeWrite.source: Pins stored source/criteria/model revisions; authoritative source/criteria service still gated

workspaceProvision.actor: Verified current session/device, expected-account match, exact Origin/CSRF and per-UID 10/minute rate admission; UID derived by commandAccount
workspaceProvision.workspace: Creates only the authenticated owner personal workspace and OWNER membership; caller role/workspace hints rejected
workspaceProvision.object: Explicit opt-in runtime-only SQL identity; target/UID-scoped command receipt, workspace, member, audit and outbox commit in one SQL transaction
workspaceProvision.source: No educational source or publication access granted
workspaceProvision.consent: Existing Firestore account/profile/billing preserved; dedicated pending/completed locator is not a permission grant

domain.actor: REQUIRED: server-verified UID/session, expected account, action-specific admission; writes require Origin/CSRF
domain.workspace: REQUIRED: current verified membership/capability, never preview role or caller workspaceId
domain.object: REQUIRED: current owner/object/action and exact revision/digest; reauthorize duplicate and in-flight work
domain.source: REQUIRED: current published source/version/rights and permitted action; withdrawal checked
domain.consent: REQUIRED: current purpose/relationship/consent/entitlement; payment is not a role

privateFile.actor: REQUIRED: current authenticated UID and permitted action; signed URL possession alone is insufficient
privateFile.object: REQUIRED: private object/asset/export ownership, quarantine/finalize checks; reauthorize downloads and issuance
privateFile.source: REQUIRED: approved media/source rights and permitted offline/export use
privateFile.consent: REQUIRED: purpose/consent, expiry/revocation; downloaded bytes have residual-access limits

privateJob.actor: REQUIRED: verified queue/service identity, scoped operation and accountable operator where applicable
privateJob.workspace: REQUIRED: reload original current owner/workspace/action; never authorize by queue payload
privateJob.object: REQUIRED: owning-store receipt/outbox, immutable command identity, revision and cancellation; no cross-store ACID claim
privateJob.source: REQUIRED: source/rights recheck at execution and delivery
privateJob.consent: REQUIRED: current purpose/consent/entitlement; expired/revoked work cannot commit

profileStage.actor: REQUIRED: current verified UID and action-specific confirmation; inferred stage is only a suggestion
profileStage.workspace: REQUIRED: own personal profile; institution/guardian/employer grants stay separate
profileStage.object: REQUIRED: one selected profile owning store, exact profile/mapping/receipt revision; undo/postpone cannot erase later work
profileStage.source: REQUIRED: accepted immutable source/criteria mapping and current publication rights
profileStage.consent: REQUIRED: current admission/relationship/purpose/consent; no automatic promotion

privateCoaching.actor: REQUIRED: current verified UID acting on own private goal; teaching role does not grant another person access
privateCoaching.workspace: REQUIRED: current personal scope; institutional membership does not expose private coaching
privateCoaching.object: REQUIRED: UID-owned goal/history and exact revision; any separately shared summary needs current audience/purpose authorization
privateCoaching.source: REQUIRED: accepted source/evidence rights for any grounded recommendation
privateCoaching.consent: REQUIRED: private purpose by default; no automatic publication, employer/guardian disclosure or model-data permission

guardian.actor: REQUIRED: verified guardian identity and permitted relationship, not a payer/role string
guardian.workspace: REQUIRED: current approved relationship scope; no blanket child workspace access
guardian.object: REQUIRED: purpose/audience/freshness-limited summary; no raw private doubts or private chat access
guardian.consent: REQUIRED: verified, unexpired and revocable relationship/consent; safeguarding disclosure rules

institution.actor: REQUIRED: verified role-appropriate learner/teacher/org/employer actor and action capability
institution.workspace: REQUIRED: current class/org/workspace membership; claimed category or admin UI is insufficient
institution.object: REQUIRED: fixed assignment/submission ownership or explicitly shared professional object; no personal/private-learning dump
institution.source: REQUIRED: approved publication/source/rubric and withdrawal scope
institution.consent: REQUIRED: role-specific purpose, consent and aggregate suppression; private coaching stays private

support.actor: REQUIRED: approved strong/step-up operator identity, scoped capability and audited reason
support.workspace: REQUIRED: case-specific tenant/subject access, no default impersonation
support.object: REQUIRED: bounded case/export/redacted diagnostic access; no unrestricted account dump
support.source: REQUIRED: disclosure/minimization policy; no implicit source reuse
support.consent: REQUIRED: accepted support/safeguarding purpose and applicable consent/exception policy; feedback is not emergency coverage

gaps.detail: Current learning UID ownership and workspace/source/criteria consistency do not establish verified workspace membership, published-source rights or withdrawal/relationship/consent enforcement.
Current present-check DTO accepts bounded authored prompt/options/answerIndex; storing/scoring that input is not authoritative source/rubric provenance or assessed educational validity.

New domain/read/list/file/export/support/voice/offline/stage operations need current action-specific authority, owning-store transactions and hosted/two-device negative evidence; none is registered by this inventory.
Human ownership, retention/deletion, provider purpose, staff step-up/audit, safeguarding and incident/release acceptance stay separately gated.
